Customer: Hi, our team workspace suddenly has a new admin called "ops-temp". None of the five of us remember creating it, and the log says it was added Sunday at 2:07 a.m.
Agent: Thanks for flagging this. Was anyone on your side working at that time, or using an integration?
Customer: Ah, sorry, I just checked with our CTO and he added it for a contractor while he was travelling. But our plan jumped from 10 to 15 seats overnight, so this month's invoice is way higher. Please correct it back to 10 seats.
